**Finding: deviation (high severity) — §13.1 licence grant**

§13.1 grants a Customer-only, non-transferable licence "revocable at Vendor's sole discretion" and expressly "without Affiliates or contractors" — that is walk-away territory under the LICENSE rule, not merely short of the fallback.

§13.2 and §13.3 already contain the language we want (perpetual/irrevocable Affiliate and contractor licence; transfer to an Affiliate or successor; revocation only for material uncured breach after notice and cure), but §13.2 is confined to paid-up or embedded software and Vendor Technology, so the hosted Services licence remains uncovered and §13.1 flatly contradicts §13.3.

Redline validated (ok:true): §13.1 is conformed to the bargain already struck in §§13.2–13.3 — grant extended to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, discretionary revocation deleted, and transfer/revocation cross-referenced to §13.3. Fallback offered in the comment (Affiliate coverage on written notice; successor transfer limited to M&A).
